name: breadcrumb
behavior: APG breadcrumb pattern (nav landmark with an accessible name; an ordered list of links; the last/current entry carries aria-current=page and is not a link; separators are decorative and hidden from assistive tech)

parts.note: the nav landmark; aria-label names the trail
ordered list; wraps rather than truncates when it cannot collapse

parts.statesNote: rest renders in content-secondary; hover/focus-visible resolve to on-surface (shadcn) or link (Salt) — a recipe difference on the same part

parts.note: the current page: aria-current=page, not a link, not focusable
decorative; aria-hidden. Chevron (shadcn / Salt LevelSeparatorIcon) or a caller-supplied glyph — recipe, same part
collapse point when the trail exceeds maxItems

anatomyNotes: Parts are the intersection of shadcn Breadcrumb and Salt Breadcrumbs. Whether overflow is a static ellipsis (shadcn) or a menu disclosure listing the hidden items (Salt) is a BEHAVIOR option declared on the root, not a variant axis — the part is the same. Salt's separate BreadcrumbTrigger/BreadcrumbLabel split is composition over one link part.
